notes.title: Welcome to Bound Beyond!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

This is our very first post — a small announcement to share some general plans and a rough roadmap for the future of the game.

As you may have noticed, the game is still a work in progress, so things are subject to adjustments and improvements. There's a road ahead before the full release, but here’s a quick look at what you can expect in the near future:

1. Closed Beta Testing
In the coming months, we’ll be selecting players for a closed beta. Once the beta build is polished enough, we’ll begin testing and gathering feedback to make the game even better.

2. Public Demo
After the closed beta, we plan to release a free demo here on Steam. While it will offer a limited environment, it will include most of the core mechanics and give you a good feel for the game.

3. Ongoing Updates & Sneak Peeks
Throughout development, we’ll continue sharing updates, behind-the-scenes content, and previews of what's coming next.

While we can’t provide an exact timeline just yet, we promise to keep you updated and share announcements as soon as we’re ready.

We deeply appreciate everyone who has taken the time to check out the game or follow this page. Thank you so much for your interest and support!
